title: 化石是怎么来的
subtitle: 骨头怎么变成石头
character: wearing a slate grey t-shirt, ochre shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration in mineral pigment style, layered earthy washes with fine dark outlines, ochre, slate grey and cream, textured and grainy

pages.zh:
我在山边
捡到一块石头，
上面有一个
弯弯的壳印。
爸爸说，那是化石。
pages.scene: The little boy squats on a hillside path holding a flat stone with a curved shell imprint on it, looking at it closely.

pages.zh:
很久以前，
一只恐龙倒在河边。
河水带来泥沙，
一层一层
把它盖住了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one dinosaur skeleton lying flat at the bottom of a cream background with several horizontal layers of sediment drawn stacked over it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
软的地方
先烂掉，不见了。
只有骨头最硬，
留在泥沙里，
没有走。
pages.scene: One dinosaur skeleton lying buried in the ground on a cream background, the bones clean and bare. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
泥沙越压越紧。
水顺着缝
渗进骨头里，
水里带着矿物，
一点一点把骨头换成石头。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one bone cut open on a cream background with small arrows of water entering it and the inside slowly filling with stone speckles. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
这件事很慢很慢。
慢到要过
几千万年。
那个时候，
地球上还没有人。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one very long horizontal bar on a cream background marked into equal sections, with a tiny mark at the far right end. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
后来地壳动了一下，
埋在底下的那一层
被顶了上来。
风一吹，雨一冲，
化石就露出来了。
pages.scene: One hillside on a cream background with tilted rock layers and one bone showing at the surface. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
挖化石要很小心。
先用刷子扫开沙，
再用小凿子
一点一点敲，
急不得。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three tools laid in a row on a cream background: one brush, one small chisel, one pick. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
挖出来以后，
要用石膏
把它整个包起来，
像打石膏一样，
免得路上碰碎了。
pages.scene: One large fossil bone wrapped in a white plaster jacket on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
运回来再一块一块拼。
缺掉的地方，
就照着别的骨头
做一个补上去，
颜色不一样。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one dinosaur skeleton outline on a cream background with most bones drawn solid and three drawn with dashed outlines. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
化石会说话。
牙齿告诉我们它吃什么，
腿骨告诉我们它跑多快，
蛋告诉我们
它怎么带孩子。
pages.scene: One tooth, one leg bone and one egg laid side by side on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
不是每只恐龙
都变得成化石。
一万只里面，
也许只有一只
运气好，被泥沙埋住。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: many small identical dinosaur silhouettes arranged in a grid on a cream background, with exactly one of them filled in a strong colour. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我把那块石头
放进口袋。
它在山里
躺了那么久，
今天被我捡到了。
pages.scene: The little boy slips the flat shell-imprint stone into his pocket, standing on the hillside path, pleased.
